# TextElementBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base class for text-based PDF elements that provides common functionality for font handling, text encoding, and line wrapping. This reduces code duplication across text elements and ensures consistent text rendering behavior.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new TextElementBase()
```

### `color`

```typescript
color: Color
```

Text color for rendering. Defaults to black if not set. Setting this marks the property as explicitly set, preventing cascade override.

### `CurrentPageToken`

```typescript
static readonly CurrentPageToken: "{{CurrentPage}}"
```

*static, read-only*

Token for injecting the current page number

### `decoration`

```typescript
decoration: TextDecoration
```

Text decoration (underline, strikethrough, overline, or a combination). Defaults to None if not set.

### `decorationColor`

```typescript
decorationColor: Color | undefined
```

Colour of the decoration lines. Undefined = use `color`, the default.

### `decorationStyle`

```typescript
decorationStyle: DecorationStyle
```

Line style for decorations (solid/wavy/dashed/dotted). Default solid.

### `decorationThickness`

```typescript
decorationThickness: number | undefined
```

Thickness of the decoration lines in points. Null = the default derived from font size (`max(0.5, fontSize / 18)`).

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'0.5pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `fontFamily`

```typescript
fontFamily: string | undefined
```

Font family name (e.g. "Helvetica", "Times", "Arial") for weight/italic resolution. When set, fontName is automatically resolved via FontFamilyResolver using the current fontWeight and italic values.

### `fontFeatures`

```typescript
fontFeatures: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | undefined
```

OpenType feature overrides for embedded text, such as { kern: 0, liga: 0 }.

### `fontName`

```typescript
fontName: string
```

The TTF/OTF path or PDF standard font name for rendering. Assigning marks the font as explicitly set, so the document-level defaultTextStyle cascade will not override it.

### `fontSize`

```typescript
fontSize: number
```

Font size for text rendering. Defaults to 12 if not set. Setting this marks the property as explicitly set, preventing cascade override.

### `fontWeight`

```typescript
fontWeight: FontWeight
```

Font weight (100-900). Normal = 400, Bold = 700. When fontFamily is set, triggers automatic resolution. When fontFamily is not set, uses the current fontName as the base family for resolution.

### `italic`

```typescript
italic: boolean
```

Whether the text should be rendered in italic/oblique style. When fontFamily is set, triggers automatic resolution. When fontFamily is not set, uses the current fontName as the base family for resolution.

### `letterSpacing`

```typescript
letterSpacing: number
```

Letter spacing (tracking) in points, added after every glyph. Default 0. Changes advances, so it is reflected in measurement and both PDF and SVG output.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'0.2mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `lineHeight`

```typescript
lineHeight: number
```

Line-height multiplier applied to font size. Defaults to 1.2 if not set. Setting this marks the property as explicitly set, preventing cascade override.

### `TotalPagesToken`

```typescript
static readonly TotalPagesToken: "{{TotalPages}}"
```

*static, read-only*

Token for injecting total pages count

### `wordSpacing`

```typescript
wordSpacing: number
```

Word spacing in points, added after every space. Default 0.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'0.5mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

## Methods

- [`applyDefaultStyleIfNotSet`](#applydefaultstyleifnotset): Applies style properties from `style` only for properties that have not been explicitly set by user code.

### `applyDefaultStyleIfNotSet`

```typescript
applyDefaultStyleIfNotSet(style: TextStyle): void
```

Applies style properties from `style` only for properties that have not been explicitly set by user code. Called by Document.generateBytes() when DocumentSettings.defaultTextStyle is set.

Writes directly to backing fields so it does NOT mark properties as "explicitly set" - a second call (e.g. after updating defaultTextStyle) can still override cascade values.
